verdict: No paid campaigns active; organic presence holding but softening across all entities.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, there was zero paid spend on Meta or Google, meaning no paid leads were generated. Your combined organic footprint — 376 Google Business Profile actions, 587 search clicks, and over 1,800 website sessions in the last 28 days — is carrying all activity on its own. GBP engagement and search clicks are trending down week-over-week at each location, which is the clearest signal that paid support is needed to sustain lead flow. We are working to get paid campaigns back online; once active, you should see lead volume and cost-per-lead figures return to the report.
